Title: NETMESSAGE:That thing looks like the first rune. Destroy it!
Translation: 那个东西看起来像第一符文。摧毁它！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Very good, Team! The next rune is near the mine entrance.
Translation: 非常好，队伍！下一个符文在矿洞入口附近。

Title: NETMESSAGE:The first mystical teleport is now open.
Translation: 第一个神秘传送门现已开启。

Title: NETMESSAGE:The second mystical teleport is now open.
Translation: 第二个神秘传送门现已开启。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Welcome to Egypt, team! \n Kel ' Rana, the dark Pharao build 4 runes to save his power. \n Destroy all 4 runes to free Egypt.
Translation: 欢迎来到埃及，队伍！ \n Kel ' Rana，黑暗法老建造了4个符文以保存他的力量。 \n 摧毁所有4个符文以解放埃及。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Good work! Go on to rune No. 3.
Translation: 干得好！继续去第三符文。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Nearly complete! The last rune isn't far.
Translation: 即将完成！最后一个符文不远了。

Title: NETMESSAGE:The third mystical teleport is now open.
Translation: 第三个神秘传送门现已开启。
